questions.statement: By this time next year, many schools ________ VR headsets to teach history.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This just states a future fact.
Correct! Future Continuous (will be + -ing) for actions that will be in progress at a specific future time.
Incorrect. This would mean the action is finished by then.

questions.explanation:
Usamos el Futuro Continuo para visualizar una acción que estará ocurriendo en un momento determinado del futuro, resaltando la continuidad del proceso.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: By 2030, scientists ________ a way to make batteries last twice as long.

options.feedback: Correct! Future Perfect (will have + past participle) for actions that will be completed before a certain time.

questions.explanation:
El Futuro Perfecto se utiliza para indicar que una acción habrá terminado antes de un punto específico en el futuro (*By 2030*).

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: In June, I ________ as a software developer for exactly ten years.

options.feedback: Correct! Future Perfect Continuous shows the duration of an action up to a future point.
Incorrect. (Possible, but C emphasizes the continuous nature better).

questions.explanation:
El Futuro Perfecto Continuo (*will have been working*) se emplea para resaltar cuánto tiempo habrá durado una actividad al llegar a una fecha futura.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Don't call me at 10:00 PM tomorrow; I ________ a webinar about AI ethics.

options.feedback: Correct! Future Continuous for an action that will be in progress at a specific moment.
Incorrect. (Describes intention, but B describes the state of being busy).

questions.explanation:
El Futuro Continuo es ideal para justificar por qué no estaremos disponibles en un momento dado del futuro, describiendo nuestra actividad en curso.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: By the end of the week, the team ________ the new app for any possible bugs.
questions.context: Describing a deadline for a tech project.

options.feedback: Correct! Future Perfect for an action completed by a deadline.

questions.explanation:
La preposición *By* seguida de una expresión de tiempo es una señal clara de que debemos usar el Futuro Perfecto para marcar la finalización de una tarea.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: In fifty years, people ________ in smart cities with zero emissions.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This would mean they stopped living there.
Correct! Describes a future state or lifestyle.

questions.explanation:
Para proyecciones sobre cómo será la vida en el futuro, el Futuro Continuo es la forma más natural de describir el entorno y las actividades cotidianas.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence implies that the tech project will be **finished** by Monday?

options.text: On Monday, we will be presenting the project.
By Monday, we will have presented the project.
We are going to present the project on Monday.
We will present the project on Monday.

questions.explanation:
A nivel B2, el estudiante debe identificar que el Futuro Perfecto (*will have presented*) se centra en el resultado y la conclusión de la acción antes de una fecha límite.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
"Do you think people will still use smartphones in 2050?"
"No, I think we ________ wearable devices by then."

options.feedback: Correct! Predicts a future standard situation or ongoing habit.

questions.explanation:
El Futuro Continuo se usa a menudo para predecir situaciones que serán "normales" o habituales en un momento lejano del futuro.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
"Why hasn't he answered the email?"
"He probably ________ it yet. He's very busy today."

options.feedback: Correct! Future Perfect can be used to make a guess about something that has (or hasn't) happened by now.
Incorrect. (Wait, this is possible, but C is the specific B2 target for speculation).

questions.explanation:
Un uso avanzado del Futuro Perfecto es realizar suposiciones sobre el presente o el pasado reciente (*speculation about the past/present*).

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Identify the error in this paragraph:
"By the time you read this, I **will have already left** (A) for the tech conference. Tomorrow morning, I **will be attending** (B) several workshops. By the end of the day, I **will have been listening** (C) to five experts. I'm sure I **will be having** (D) a great time."
questions.context: Identifying an error in a future-oriented tech blog.

options.feedback: Correct! This should be Future Perfect (*will have listened*) because it refers to the number of experts heard by a deadline, not the duration of the activity itself.
Incorrect. Correct Future Continuous for a state.

questions.explanation:
Cuando contamos cuántas veces hemos hecho algo o cuántos elementos hemos completado ante una fecha límite, debemos usar el Futuro Perfecto Simple, no el Continuo.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which statement best describes a **successful completion** of a long-term AI development goal?
questions.context: Judging the best future projection for an AI project.

options.text: We will be developing the AI for five years in 2028.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Just describes the ongoing work.

options.text: We will develop the AI by 2028.
By 2028, we will have successfully integrated the AI into our systems.
options.feedback: Correct! Emphasizes the successful result at a future point.

options.text: In 2028, the AI will have been working for a while.

questions.explanation:
Para comunicar logros y éxitos proyectados en un contexto profesional, el Futuro Perfecto es la estructura más precisa y que transmite mayor seguridad.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Choose the best completion:
"The transition to a digital economy is fast. By next decade, most paper transactions ________. Instead, we ________ blockchain for almost everything."
questions.context: Completing a text about digital transformation.

options.text: will have disappeared / will be using
options.feedback: Correct! Completion of a change and the following continuous state.

questions.explanation: Este ejercicio final evalúa la capacidad de secuenciar el futuro: un cambio que se completa (*will have disappeared*) y el nuevo estado permanente que le sigue (*will be using*).
